segments.text: Queſt. 96. What doth God require in the ſecond Command?
Anſ. That we in no Wiſe repreſent God by Images, nor worſhip Him in any other Way than He has commanded in his Word.
Queſt. 97. Are Images then not at all to be made?

Anſw. God neither can, nor may be repreſented by any Means: But as to Creatures, tho' they may be repreſented, yet God forbids to make, or have any Reſemblance of them, either in Order to worſhip them, or to ſerve God by them.
Queſt. 98. But may not Images be tolerated in the Churches, as Books to the Laity?
Anſ. No; for we muſt not pretend to be wiſer than God, who will have his People taught, not by dumb Images, but by the lively preaching of his Word.
